title: Special repairs & Civil Maintenance and Improvement of Lighthouse Tower, Allied strucures, Compound wall etc, at Pulicat Lighthouse and DGNSS station
summary: Percentage-rate e-tender for special repairs, civil maintenance and improvement of the lighthouse tower, allied structures and compound wall at Pulicat Lighthouse and DGNSS Station, Chennai Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Pulicat Lighthouse and DGNSS station
sites.work: Special repairs, civil maintenance and improvement of lighthouse tower, allied structures, compound wall etc.

scope.item: Special repairs & Civil Maintenance and Improvement of Lighthouse Tower, Allied structures, Compound wall etc.

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; validity stated as three months (table) and 90 days (clause 1.1). Tender fee and EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate. Percentage rate contract.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%; only fully completed works with completion certificate; values enhanced at 7% simple per annum; certificates below Executive Engineer rank not considered
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of building, or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
Average annual turnover on construction works (CA certified) at least 40% of estimated cost in last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2025
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution with qualification and experience
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); affidavit/self-attestation of not being blacklisted
List of relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL; Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)
notes: Scanned Section-I NIT only; no BOQ. NIT table skips serial number 5. Download and bid submission period 21.11.2025 10:00 to 10.12.2025 15:00; opening 11.12.2025 15:00.
